extension.description: [WIP][DEV] Continue of bilikodi project, An New Unofficial third-party bilibili client on kodi
[WIP][DEV] 自 Bilikodi 项目的延续，一个“新的”非官方的第三方b站客户端 on Kodi 旧项目代码太神作了于是我推翻重构，， 按情况来讲应该可以支持 Kodi 19/20/21/22
